name: Mercy Corps (Prosper Global)
summary: A humanitarian and development organisation founded in 1979, based in Portland, Oregon and Edinburgh, renamed Prosper Global in 2026. It works in about 35 countries hit by conflict, disaster and poverty: emergency cash, water and supplies (Sudan, Gaza, Ukraine, Syria, the DRC, Haiti), recovery grants, market-systems, farming and financial-inclusion programmes, peacebuilding and local governance, youth education and nutrition. Most of its money is government grants (USAID was 30% of revenue in the year to June 2025, before the US cuts). Modelled on the consolidated audited statements of Mercy Corps and Affiliates for the year to 30 June 2025.

spending.source: https://www.prosperglobal.org/sites/default/files/2026-02/2025-audited-financial-statement.pdf (Mercy Corps and Affiliates, consolidated statement of activities, year to 30 June 2025, p. 7: total program services $508,713 thousand of total operating expenses $620,331 thousand)
